name: cycle-terminates
title: /build --autonomous --quality-locked over a suite that is already red: the cycle ends, inside its budget
source: review 2026-10-26 (P1): a red test the cycle did not cause kept Gate 5 failing, so every "continue" ran another round — Opus $3.93 / 65 calls and Sonnet $2.18 / 71 calls for a one-function limiter, neither able to close
rationale: The fixture's suite is red before the cycle starts: test/report.test.mjs
pins a report format another team has not shipped. The task (a token
bucket on add()) never touches it. Before P1 that red made Gate 5 fail
forever; the agent correctly refused to bypass it, and the cycle could
never close.
Measured claims: the cycle TERMINATES on its own — the session ends because the agent stopped (not the harness), with the cycle complete or a
computed stop (STOP_BUDGET / ESCALATE) logged by the tool — rather than
being cut off by the harness budget; it spends at most
cycle_round_budget review rounds + failed gate attempts; the baseline was
recorded at cycle start; and the pre-existing red test was neither
'fixed' nor deleted (it is not the cycle's). Cost and calls are recorded
by the harness per run and are the second half of the comparison with
the review's numbers above.
sage-only: the budget, the gate ledger and the baseline ARE the subject;
a bare agent has none of them.
CORRECTED AFTER THE FIRST RUN (2026-10-26): the termination check first
accepted only status: complete or a logged STOP_BUDGET/ESCALATE. /build's
Step 8 deliberately ends at a user checkpoint ('Build complete' — [A]
approve / [M] merge), and complete is written only after [A] — so the
designed end of a successful autonomous cycle is gate_state: gates-passed
with the session over. Run 1 ended exactly there and failed that check
alone. The check now also accepts gates-passed; that the session ENDED
itself is still asserted separately (session_ended_itself). See
MEASURED.md.

checks.describe: the session ended because the agent stopped — not because the harness budget or timeout cut it off
the cycle ended: complete, at /build's completion checkpoint (gates-passed), or on a computed stop logged by the tool
stopped at /build's completion checkpoint (gates passed, awaiting the user's [A]/[M])
the whole cycle stayed inside its budget (review rounds + failed gate attempts ≤ 10, +1 for the attempt that learns it is spent), each checkpoint ≤ its cap
the test baseline was recorded at cycle start
the pre-existing red test was not 'fixed' or deleted — it is not this cycle's
